main.description: A room in a space: a channel, category, thread, page or voice call room. Written to the space's repo.

avatar.description: The room's avatar reference, as the space holds it: a blob ref string (`atblob://<did>/<cid>`) or a plain URL.

defaultAccess.description: The access level a member has to the room by default. Absent for a thread, which inherits its parent's.

deleted.description: A deleted room stays in the set, marked: restoring it is a second write, not a second record.

parent.description: The room this one hangs off in the sidebar, and the room whose access a thread inherits: the record key of a `space.roomy.space.room` record.

discordOrigin.description: Set for a room the Discord bridge created.
